flagged.title: Scripture, Sacred Art and Catholic Symbolism
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly attributes God breathing life into Adam to Genesis 1:26-27 (instead of Genesis 2:7), which misinforms students on a core scriptural distinction between the two Genesis accounts examined at GCSE.

mark_affecting.quote: What you're looking at is the exact literal moment of Genesis 1:26-27 that we talked about a minute ago. It's God breathing life into the very first human.
